question: How do I get my files after I purchase?
answer: Everything is delivered digitally. Once your payment goes through, Etsy sends you a download link right away, and you can also find your files anytime under Your Account > Purchases and Reviews on Etsy.

question: Do you ship anything physical?
answer: No, everything in the shop is a digital download. There's nothing mailed to you - you print it yourself at home or at a print shop if you want a physical copy.

question: What file format do the products come in?
answer: Most listings come as a PDF for printing, and the planners/trackers also include an editable version (usually a Canva template link) if you want to customize text or colors before printing.

question: I didn't get my download email, what do I do?
answer: First check your spam folder, Etsy's delivery emails sometimes land there. If it's still missing after a few minutes, message me through Etsy and I'll resend the files directly.

question: Can I get a refund?
answer: Since these are digital products and the files are delivered instantly, I can't offer refunds once a file has been downloaded. If something is genuinely broken or missing, message me and I'll fix it or make it right.

question: Do you accept payment plans?
answer: Etsy doesn't support payment plans for digital items, so it's a single payment at checkout through whatever method Etsy offers you (card, PayPal, Etsy gift card, etc).

question: Are there any hidden fees?
answer: No, the price you see on the listing is what you pay, aside from any tax Etsy calculates for your location at checkout.

question: Can I edit the planner before I print it?
answer: Yes, most planners come with an editable Canva link. You just open it, make a free Canva account if you don't have one already, and you can change text, colors, and sometimes fonts before downloading your own PDF.

question: Do I need Canva Pro to edit the templates?
answer: No, everything is built using the free version of Canva. Some templates may show you Canva Pro elements as suggestions, but you're never required to pay for Canva to finish your download.

question: Can I change the colors on the resume template?
answer: Yes. Resume templates are editable in Canva, so you can swap the accent color, change the font, and rearrange sections if you want a slightly different layout.

question: I'm not able to edit the Canva file, what's wrong?
answer: Usually this means the link opened as a 'view only' file instead of making you a copy. Look for a button that says 'Use template' or 'Make a copy' near the top right of the Canva page - that creates your own editable version.

question: What size paper should I print these on?
answer: Everything is designed for standard US Letter size (8.5 x 11 in). If you're outside the US, most print shops can rescale to A4 without cutting off content, but there might be a small white border.

question: Will printing this use a lot of ink?
answer: No, that's actually something I design around on purpose. All the planners and trackers use white backgrounds and simple line work instead of heavy color blocks, specifically so they're cheap to print at home.

question: Can I print these in black and white?
answer: Yes, they're designed to still look clean in black and white, since I keep the color usage pretty minimal to begin with.

question: Should I print double sided?
answer: That's up to you, but most people print single sided since a few of the trackers reference the page before or after them and it's easier to flip between separate sheets.

question: Can I take this to Staples or FedEx to print instead of printing at home?
answer: Yes, the PDF works fine at any print shop. Just double check they're printing at 100 percent scale and not 'fit to page,' or the margins can shift slightly.

question: Can I resell the planners I bought?
answer: No, these are for personal use only. You can print as many copies as you want for yourself or your own household, but reselling or redistributing the files themselves isn't allowed.

question: Can I use this planner for my small business or clients?
answer: Not as-is. The license only covers personal use, so if you want to use a template commercially (like handing it out to your own clients), reach out to me first so we can figure out a commercial license.

question: Can I share the file with a friend?
answer: I'd rather you send them the Etsy listing so they can grab their own copy. Sharing the actual file isn't covered under the license, even between friends or family.

question: Do I own the copyright to the design?
answer: No, I keep the copyright to the design itself. What you're buying is a license to print and use it personally, not ownership of the design.

question: What's the difference between the budget planner and the debt payoff tracker?
answer: The budget planner is more general - income, monthly expenses, savings goals. The debt payoff tracker is focused specifically on paying down individual debts, with space to log balances, interest rates, and payments over time.

question: Does the fitness tracker include a workout plan?
answer: No, it's a tracking tool, not a coaching program. You log your own workouts, weight, or measurements into it. It doesn't come with prewritten exercises or routines.

question: Is the debt tracker good for the snowball method or the avalanche method?
answer: It works for either one, since it just gives you space to list debts and log payments. You can order the rows by smallest balance first (snowball) or highest interest first (avalanche), whichever you're using.

question: Does the budget planner work for biweekly pay instead of monthly?
answer: Yes, there's a note on the listing about this, but you can just relabel the monthly columns as pay periods instead. The layout works fine either way.

question: Can I use the resume template for a career change?
answer: Yes, nothing about the template locks you into one type of job. It's really just a layout, so it works for whatever job title and experience you drop into it.

question: Do you have a version of the resume template with a photo?
answer: Not currently, most of my resume templates skip photos since a lot of US employers prefer resumes without one. If enough people ask I might add a version with a photo slot.

question: How many pages are in the debt payoff tracker?
answer: It depends on the listing, but most versions are around 10 to 15 pages, including a summary page, an overview page, and individual tracking pages per debt.

question: Can I request a custom color scheme?
answer: For some listings, yes. Message me through Etsy first and I'll let you know if that specific product supports a custom request and whether there's an extra fee.

question: Do you offer any bundles?
answer: Sometimes I'll bundle a few related products together (like the budget planner and debt tracker) at a discount. Check the shop's front page, bundles are usually pinned near the top when they're available.

question: What if I'm not happy with my purchase?
answer: Message me and tell me what's going on. I can't always do a refund because of the digital delivery, but I can usually help fix formatting issues or answer questions about how to use the template properly.
